context: A uni student and a teen walk after a movie
purpose: Teach: 正体/気力/叫ぶ/誘わ/親族/見つめる/うれしく/年上

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あの映画のラスト、犯人の正体、桜は気づいてた?
lines.en: That film's ending — did you catch who the culprit was?
lines.style: Curious, gentle lean-in. Engaged but not pushing. Warm tone looking for connection. Relaxed pacing, natural cadence of someone asking a friend they're genuinely interested in.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いえ、最後の叫ぶシーンで初めて分かりました。
lines.en: No, not until that final scream scene. That's when it clicked.
lines.style: Slight self-consciousness underneath. Honest admission without defensiveness. Small pause before 'that's when'—thinking back through the moment. Soft but clear.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 伏線の親族関係、複雑だったよな。
lines.en: The family connections they set up early on — yeah, that was layered.
lines.style: Thoughtful half-nod in the voice. Slower tempo. Acknowledging the craft without lecturing. Genuine appreciation for complexity. Trailing slightly as if still unpacking it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩に誘われて来てうれしくて、つい喋りすぎちゃいました。
lines.en: I was just so happy you invited me. I think I talked way too much.
lines.style: Quick bright energy, then softens into genuine embarrassment. Self-aware smile in the voice. Not apologetic, just noticing herself. Warmth underneath the admission.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 年上らしく聞き役に回ったよ。気力余ってるね、桜は。
lines.en: I got to listen, which is what a senpai should do anyway. You've got a lot of life in you, Sakura.
lines.style: Gentle deflection—he's dismissing his own restraint. Warm observation at the end, like he's noticing something he likes. Steady, unrushed. Genuine compliment, not practiced.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 帰り道、街の灯りを見つめる時間、余韻に浸ります。
lines.en: Walking home, I'll probably just watch the city lights for a while. Let it all settle.
lines.style: Quiet, inward-turning. Slower pace. Almost meditative—not sad, just... lingering. Soft attack on the opening. Gentle fadeout, like speaking half to herself.
